title: Preservation of Scripture
definition: The preservation of Scripture means that God, by His providence, has preserved His Word so that His people may continue to know, trust, read, teach, and obey it.
summary: God has not allowed His Word to disappear from the earth. Through copying, transmission, translation, preaching, and providential care, Scripture remains available to the people of God.
christFocus: Jesus declared that God's Word would not pass away. The preservation of Scripture serves the continuing mission of Christ, who sends His people to proclaim the Gospel to the nations.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content: Preservation does not mean every manuscript copy was made without any copying variation. It means God has faithfully preserved His Word so that the church is not left without the Scriptures He gave.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: Believers can have confidence that God has not lost His Word. The same Lord who spoke is able to preserve His revelation for the good of His people and the spread of the Gospel.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Treasure access to Scripture. Read it, teach it, memorize it, translate it, distribute it, and guard it from neglect, distortion, and misuse.
